h1: Custom Felt Pennants for Branded Events
metaDescription: Order custom felt pennants for your next event. Perfect for giveaways, schools, and promotions. Bulk discounts available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Felt pennants offer a classic, textured look that stands out from standard printed banners. Their soft, durable material makes them ideal for long-term display at trade shows, school spirit events, or retail promotions. Customize with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a premium feel. Perfect for bulk orders that need to last season after season.
heroAltText: Custom felt pennants with embroidered logo in team colors, displayed on a wall
